How Chronolyte approaches affordable projects

Chronolyte offers scoped website projects with starting quotes from $199 for simple landing pages and from $499 for small-business websites. These are starting prices, not guaranteed totals. We discuss content, integrations and deliverables before confirming a fixed quotation.

Can a website launch in 48 hours?

A simple one-page launch may be possible in 48 hours when all copy, brand assets and approvals are ready. Most qualifying brochure websites target delivery within 7 days. Complex e-commerce, custom integrations, mobile apps and SaaS need separate estimates.

What to compare before buying

  • Ownership and access to domain, hosting and source code
  • Mobile usability, forms and SEO essentials
  • Revisions, content requirements, accessibility and testing
  • Maintenance costs, integration limits and support

Questions to ask Chronolyte

What is included in the starting quote? Which inputs must I supply? Does the deadline include feedback rounds? Will I receive handover access? We answer these in a tailored proposal.
